# LEARNING-013 — ipc-channels EXPECTED_CHANNELS is hand-maintained despite the "auto-generated" comment

## Signal

Adding a new `craft-fork:*` RPC channel group makes `apps/electron/src/shared/__tests__/ipc-channels.test.ts` fail:

```
error: expect(received).toBe(expected)
  contains exactly N channel strings
Expected: 351
Received: 358
```

The test file says, right above the list:

```
// Auto-generated by scripts/ipc-inventory.ts — DO NOT edit by hand.
const EXPECTED_CHANNELS: string[] = [
```

…but there is **no `scripts/ipc-inventory.ts`** in the repo:

```
$ ls scripts/ipc-inventory.ts
# (no such file)
```

## Root cause

The generator script referenced in the banner comment does not exist on this fork (it was never ported, or was removed). `EXPECTED_CHANNELS` is a frozen, alphabetically-sorted snapshot of every wire string in `RPC_CHANNELS`. The three assertions (exact count, sorted deep-equality, no duplicates) exist to make any channel add/rename fail CI until the snapshot is updated **by hand**. Following the banner and hunting for the generator wastes time.

## Fix

Edit `EXPECTED_CHANNELS` directly. Insert each new wire string in its **alphabetical** position (the sorted-equality assertion enforces order). For a `craft-fork:triggerServer:*` group:

```
  'craft-fork:bgAgents:setKeepAlive',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:createApiKey',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:getConfig',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:getStatus',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:revokeApiKey',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:start',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:stop',
  'craft-fork:triggerServer:updateConfig',
  'credentials:healthCheck',
```

Then run:

```bash
cd apps/electron && bun test src/shared/__tests__/ipc-channels.test.ts
```

Also remember the *sibling* obligation: every new channel must be classified in exactly one of `LOCAL_ONLY_CHANNELS` / `REMOTE_ELIGIBLE_CHANNELS` in `packages/shared/src/protocol/routing.ts`, or `packages/shared/src/protocol/__tests__/routing.test.ts` fails its exhaustiveness check.

## Recurrence

Every time a channel group is added or renamed — i.e. every fork RPC feature (PLAN-011 `bgAgents`, PLAN-012 `triggerServer`, and every future `craft-fork:*` group).

## Prevention

Either (a) port a real `scripts/ipc-inventory.ts` that regenerates the block, or (b) fix the banner to say "hand-maintained — insert new strings alphabetically." Until then, treat the "DO NOT edit by hand" comment as inaccurate and edit by hand. This entry is the greppable pointer.
